top_signals.title: Iran escalates threats as third U.S. carrier arrives in Middle East, tanker struck in Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Iran has ratcheted up threats against U.S. forces as a third American aircraft carrier arrived in the Gulf, stoking fears of a resumption of military tensions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Jim Cramer says Nvidia’s leadership shake-up won’t derail the AI trade
top_signals.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer pushed back against fears that Nvidia's leadership shake-up could unravel the AI boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
